transcript:
**Agent:** Good afternoon! Thank you for calling TechSolutions SaaS. This is Sarah, how can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi Sarah, I’m having some trouble with my billing. I was charged twice this month for my subscription.

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear that! Let me pull up your account and take a look at the charges for you. Could you please provide me with your email address?

**Customer:** Sure, it’s john.doe@example.com.

**Agent:** Thank you, John. One moment while I check that. … Okay, I see the duplicate charge you mentioned. It looks like it was due to a system error on our end. 

**Customer:** That’s frustrating. I really don’t want to pay double for the same service!

**Agent:** I completely understand, John. We will issue a refund for the extra charge right away. It should reflect in your account within 3-5 business days. 

**Customer:** That’s good to hear. Will I be charged again after this month, or is my subscription stable?

**Agent:** Your subscription will remain at the same rate unless you decide to upgrade to our Pro plan, which has more features and can add additional users.

**Customer:** What features does the Pro plan include? 

**Agent:** The Pro plan includes advanced analytics, priority support, and integration with third-party apps, among other benefits. Would that interest you?

**Customer:** I’m not sure yet. I’ll think about it. But I need to get my refund sorted first.

**Agent:** Absolutely, I’ll make sure that’s processed right away. If you have any other questions about the Pro plan or anything else, feel free to reach out.

**Customer:** Thank you, Sarah. I appreciate your help.

**Agent:** My pleasure, John! You’ll receive an email confirmation for your refund shortly. Have a great day!
